purpose: Document first-party city-specific registry evidence and bounded anonymous parcel geometry/schema review.
assessment: ANCFCC lists cadastral and land-conservation offices in Tangier and provides a cadastral-plan request service keyed by land-title number. The Agence Urbaine de Tanger public geoportal describes planning-document layers and localizes land/address references, while its published service scope is planning boundaries/documents rather than parcel-vector geometry. No anonymous parcel geometry or schema was verified; no title number or form was submitted.
registryAssessment: ANCFCC’s official office directory lists cadastral and land-conservation offices in Tanger and Tanger Bani Makada; this is direct city-specific registration/survey service evidence.

officialPrimarySources.observation: ANCFCC’s official office directory lists both Conservation Foncière and Cadastre offices in Tanger and Tanger Bani Makada.
Official online cadastral-plan request form is indexed with a title-number field; page reader returned 403. No title number was used.
ANCFCC describes its statutory role in land registration, cadastre and cartography.
Official Arabic product page defines cadastral plans and map sheets for registered and pending registered properties, but exposes no anonymous map API.
Agence Urbaine de Tanger describes its urban-planning geoportal as displaying Tangier wilaya boundaries, document study areas and planning-document progress; this is not cadastral geometry.
Official published planning documents include Tangier arrondissement plans and planning boundaries; no parcel-vector schema is offered.
